thesis: Pre-open headlines for 2026-09-15 emphasize renewed macro pressures, highlighted by 'Stocks drop, oil climbs and Treasury yields hit 19-year high', alongside softening labor market signs in Europe/UK and carryover concerns regarding AI valuation warnings and rising rate-hike expectations. Company-specific items in the pack (Meta Muse monetization projections, Korn Ferry acquisition, Chinese vehicle sales decline, routine politician disclosures) do not provide an actionable catalyst for altering our allocation. Our balanced 4-position book—holding broad equity core VTI, fixed-income ballast BND, and technology growth sleeves NVDA and XLK—remains properly diversified (cap 6), keeps all single-name positions well below the 35% cap (VTI ~28%, NVDA ~18%), and maintains our $35.00 cash reserve (~33% of equity, comfortably exceeding the 15% floor) to absorb ongoing rate and macroeconomic volatility without forced portfolio turnover.
